title: Limits of mapping packages and tangents of Sobolev maps
summary: We show the existence of ultralimits of sequences of Hajlasz-Sobolev mappings $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ when $X_i$ converges to a limit space in the pointed measured Gromov (pmG) sense, partially extending recent results in [T. Ikonen and S. Wenger, (2026), arXiv:2603.05246]. We moreover demonstrate that the mappings pmG-converge to the ultralimit in a suitable sense, and obtain Arzela-Ascoli theorems in the context of pmG-convergence.
